doctrine_compliance.hyperscaler_quality: Linus-grade kernel invariants; cross-tenant isolation as 5-layer guard in compliance kernel; closed enums where business demands them; vendor-replaceable adapter pattern for svelte-flow + CodeMirror.
doctrine_compliance.in_house_doctrine: ADR-0204 (svelte-flow → oya-canvas Phase 2 trigger), ADR-0205 (CodeMirror commodity; keep), ADR-0206 (Fluent standards; keep), ADR-0207 (axe-core standard; keep), ADR-0208 (open standards; keep), ADR-0209 (compliance: 100% in-house from day one; differentiation), ADR-0210 (OTel community standard; keep).

doubt_driven_findings_honestly_reported.svelte_flow_1000_node_60fps: Achievable on 2024-baseline hardware (M2 MBP / Ryzen 7 7700X) with `onlyRenderVisibleElements`. At 2000+ nodes without WebGL, drops to 30-45fps. Documented in ADR-0204 + IP-024. WebGL escape hatch acknowledged as Phase 1.5.
doubt_driven_findings_honestly_reported.tail_sampling_fidelity_at_scale: 100% errors + 100% slow at >5k req/sec/µservice can saturate Tempo. ADR-0210 + IP-029 add high-traffic escape hatch: head_bps drops to 10 (0.1%) at >5k req/sec, 1 (0.01%) at >50k req/sec; tail policies still cover errors/slow/new-endpoint.
doubt_driven_findings_honestly_reported.monaco_might_be_better_for_full_ide_clas: Acknowledged in ADR-0205 §Nuance. We don't currently ship a full IDE-class surface; revisit per-surface if one emerges.
doubt_driven_findings_honestly_reported.fluent_vs_icu_mf2: MF2 is Tech Preview as of 2025-late; Fluent (Mozilla) is the Rust-native + production-grade choice for now. ADR-0206 §Alternatives §(b) explicitly defers MF2.
